query: SELECT s.id, s.nome, cse.subsetorNome FROM setores s LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT subsetorNome FROM custo_setor_despesa) cse ON UPPER(s.nome) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(cse.subsetorNome), '%') OR UPPER(cse.subsetorNome) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(s.nome), '%') ORDER BY s.nome;
